note: Big-rig friendly. Open to all (not a members-only club despite the name). Private 1.5-mi catch-and-release fly-fishing-only stretch of the Conejos River for guests (rod fees extra, with package deals for RV guests). Near Antonito, the Cumbres & Toltec RR and the Rio Grande NF. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $48/night daily rate (operator page, undated), full hookups with 50-amp, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi, laundry, phone reservations. Changed season Apr 1 - Nov 17 -> year-round ('Open all four Seasons'), site count 14 -> 34 (operator site map). Cleared directory-only military discount. Not membership: nightly rates are posted for anyone and the pages never mention members. Under the US$50 gate; no gateway within 40 km; family has not stayed. Showers, dump and 50-ft max (derived) not stated by the operator; left.
flags: Membership check (name says 'Club'): not a membership park. The operator sells nightly stays to the public - 'Our daily rate is $48 per day, which includes full hookups, electricity, and Wi-Fi' and 'Book your stay with us today' - and no page mentions members or dues; the 'Club'/'Preserve' refers to the private 1.5 miles of Conejos River 'reserved exclusively for our guests'.

Price gate: $48/night base, under US$50 (no mandatory per-night fees stated). Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Great Sand Dunes NP 94 km); the family has not stayed. The rate page carries no year (site footer ©2023), though it was live on 2026-10-26 and matched the 2026-10-16 read.

Long-stay tests: passes - a posted nightly rate, phone booking, and transient reviews ('On a 2 week trip through Colorado ...'); some sites are mainly long-term ('can be reserved for short term too'), monthly $22/day plus electric is offered.
Presence: operator website live with phone 719-376-2274 (matches the entry); booking by phone only.
